description: A round white base with a threaded center sits on the tabletop, with a separate white cross-shaped support piece off to the right. The right hand moves in from the right to pick up the cross-shaped piece (right-hand object), brings it over the round base, and lowers it onto the center post while the left hand hovers nearby to steady the base; the right hand adjusts and twists the cross piece slightly as it seats into place.
